stage1.impression: Clean, noise-free red acrylic against a featureless high-key white. It reads as a careful CG render, not a macro photograph. The frame has no single subject: the horn's underside crowds the top left, see-through internal boxes and posts layer up into a confusing collage, the right face sinks into a flat muddy oxblood, and the cut sheet edge, which should be the jewel, reads as a dull grey stripe.

blocking_9: The corner and its 20 mm polished edge must be the unmistakable subject, centred or on a third, with the horn out of frame or reduced to a soft sliver
The polished sheet edges must carry a crisp, bright specular line and glow red (edge-lit), not read as neutral grey (edge column lum_p95 > 200, r_median clearly above g)
The right face must hold transmitted red with a graduated highlight, not a flat dark plane (median lum 60-100, range > 25)
No denoiser smear in the dark red areas; glints must be sharp, not blotchy
The top face must keep its colour and show the top edge's thickness as a defined line, not a washed pink haze

defects.what: The horn's underside and its fixings dominate the top left and compete with the corner, the stated subject
The vertical polished corner edge reads neutral grey (median RGB 91/82/82) with no specular line: no polish, no edge glow
The right face is flat dark oxblood (lum median 34.5, range 6): dead, airless area
The see-through internal boxes, posts and shelf edges stack into a cluttered collage of ghosted planes
Blotchy, smeared red glows on the shelf edge: denoiser artefacts
Flat muddy red at the bottom right (lum median 49, range 14) with no modelling
The top face is washed to pale pink (lum 216, G 207) and the top edge's thickness is a soft, low-contrast band (edge width 110 px)
A post's sliver clipped by the right frame edge

changes.problem: The frame has no single subject: the horn fills the top left and the corner sits off-axis among the ghosted internals.

evidence.measured: The horn occupies about 25% of the frame; the corner edge is a 30 px grey column at x 755-785

change.to: target the cabinet's top front corner (the vertical edge now at x≈770, top at y≈640), camera lowered to z 0.95 so the eye sits just above the top face and the horn leaves the frame; lens 180 mm; put the corner on the left third with the top edge on the upper third

changes.expected: One vertical polished edge and one horizontal top edge meeting at a third; horn absent or a soft sliver under 5% of the frame; less internal clutter in view.

changes.problem: The polished 20 mm edge, the purpose of the frame, shows no polish: no specular line and no edge glow.

evidence.measured: lum median 84.7, p95 115.6, RGB 91/82/82 (grey, not red)

change.to: size [0.12,2.0], orbit set so its reflection lands on the vertical corner face (about azimuth +55 relative to the new camera, elevation 10), strength 9.0; add a second narrow strip low behind the speaker (azimuth 160, elevation 5) so light enters the sheet and exits the edge as red glow

changes.expected: A crisp, bright hairline along the corner beside a saturated red edge glow; the edge reads as polished cast acrylic.

changes.problem: The right face is a flat, dead dark plane with no transmitted light or gradient.

change.to: azimuth 150, elevation 25, irradiance 35, so the right face is transilluminated; and the glossy flag at [1.35,2.1,1.2] turned to face the right side so it lays a long graduated reflection down it

changes.expected: The right face glows mid ruby, brighter at the top and falling off downward.

changes.problem: The top face is washed to pale pink and the top edge's thickness reads as a soft, low-contrast band.

evidence.measured: lum median 216, RGB 251/207/204; the top edge's step is -60 over 110 px

changes.expected: The top face holds a saturated pink-red and the 20 mm edge below it separates as a defined band.

changes.problem: The denoiser smears the low-light red glows into blotches.

evidence.measured: Seen in a 1:1 crop: soft, smudged red patches at about (1020,1390) and (1440,1350) with no defined edges

change.to: 512 / 0.005 / 10 (keep denoise on at the lower noise floor)

changes.expected: Sharp internal glints; the caustic spots have defined shapes.

changes.problem: The bottom right is a flat, unmodelled dark red.

change.to: center [0.9,-1.4,0.4], size [1.2,0.6], normal toward the speaker's right face, reflect_only kept

changes.expected: A soft white reflection grading across the lower right face, lifting it without flattening it.

changes.problem: The ghosted internal structure behind the corner reads as clutter.

evidence.measured: At least six overlapping translucent planes and edges visible through the front sheet

change.from: view that looks through the front sheet into the cabinet
change.to: angle the view so the side face behind the corner is seen near grazing, which raises its Fresnel reflection of the white sweep and veils the internals

changes.expected: The faces read as solid polished sheets; internals at most a faint shadow.

out_of_scope.request: Check the acrylic edge material (absorption, edge tint, polish roughness): a polished cast edge should look deeper red than the face, not grey.
out_of_scope.why: The edge's colour is the speaker's material; if relighting (c2) does not make it red, the cause is in the model, which the critic may not change.

out_of_scope.request: The visible internal boxes and posts behind the sheet
out_of_scope.why: They are parts of the speaker; only the view of them may change.
